messages:
maria: Quick ping — PR #482 (migration guide + SDK snippets) is ready for review. docs preview: https://ci.redwood.example/docs/preview/482. Hoping to merge before today's release window at 17:00 PT. Who can pick this up?

jon: I can take a look in ~30m. Is this blocking the release?

maria: Not blocking, but would prefer to merge to avoid a doc hotfix post-release. Main changes: migration steps, new SDK v2 snippets, and a small note about default timeouts.

ashley: I glanced at the preview — I noticed a broken anchor in the Auth section. Happy to open a tiny fix if you want.

maria: Thanks — here's the warning from the build: ```WARNING: broken link to #authentication-header``` I suspect the heading ID changed when we renamed the subheading.

sam: Reassigning per the reviewer rotation: @jon you're on docs review this week per the rotation doc. Can you confirm you'll take this? cc: @elena for backup.

jon: Confirmed, I'll review now. If I can't finish before 4:30pm PT I'll ping for handoff.

docs-bot: docs-preview completed for PR #482 — status: succeeded (with warnings). Preview: https://ci.redwood.example/docs/preview/482

ashley: Opened a micro-PR #483 fixing the anchor and a minor wording tweak in the Auth section. No preview needed, it's a one-line anchor fix.

maria: Perfect. If jon gives LGTM, plan is to merge after CI settles. Prefer merge at ~16:30 PT so it's included in the pre-release snapshot. :thumbsup:

jon: Left 2 tiny nits inline (nit: code fence language, nit: wording). Both non-blocking. Re-ran local preview and looks fine. LGTM once the anchor fix is merged. :eyes:

maria: Merging now — thanks all. Will watch the docs deploy.

maria: Merged PR #482 and #483 (combined, fast-forward). Triggering docs deploy: `deploy/docs --tag docs-release/2026-03-21`

devops-bot: docs deploy succeeded for tag docs-release/2026-03-21 — https://status.redwood.example/deploys/789 :rocket:

maria: Thanks team — rotation coverage worked well. Note for next week: consider adding a short checklist for migration-guide PRs (snippet validation + anchor checks) so reviewers can skim faster.

elena: +1 on checklist. I'll draft one and drop it in the docs-review playbook.

jon: Thanks, will make reviews quicker.
